headline: Microsoft joins AI cost-cutting trend by relying more on its own models
snapshot: Microsoft is the latest Silicon Valley giant to cut back on its AI spending. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.

live_newsroom.headline: Discord admits AI moderation bug wrongfully banned users over harmless images
live_newsroom.snapshot: The company confirmed that the issue had been affecting accounts since May, with an additional 200 users banned over the weekend before its team identified and fixed the problem. The story matters because AI is moving deeper into legal and regulatory territory, where product speed, data rights, safety obligations and public accountability can affect adoption.
